desc: 纯黑多尺寸乳胶气球派对布置，白底主图到宴会收口共九镜
leaf: 黑色乳胶气球多尺寸派对装饰套装
name: 纯黑多尺寸派对气球套装款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：把全套球体按直径递减排成一组球簇，用纯净剪影和真实高光赢得点击
一秒传达核心利益：深色场里用一条掠射高光证明纯色哑光质感，只留一个主张位
shots.textZone: 顶部与左侧留白区放主标题位，其下一行空白参数位

shots.intent: 放大买家最怕的翻车点：现场暖光下发灰不透色，与冷白光下的正色形成同机位双栏对照
用微距证明料子与做工：球面均匀无杂质、收口颈位完整不破，消除质量疑虑
代入白场布置效果：低角度仰视球链扫过画面上缘，让买家看见自己现场能复刻的规模
展示暗场高级用法：同色球簇与干花、金属箱体堆出仪式感，拉高客单想象空间
让买家挑选：俯视色卡横排加下方球簇，留空白标注位说明同系列可选范围
shots.textZone: 顶部横条留白放系列标题位，每格下方为空白标注槽

shots.intent: 消除尺寸疑虑：同基线阶梯排列加空白规格行与参照物，让买家自行判断用量与效果
shots.textZone: 每格上方的空白标注位与其下两行空白参数位

shots.intent: 收口下单：人物背影托举超大单件立于拱门下，下方留空白优惠位收束整套布置
shots.textZone: 底部中央空白优惠位与短按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF packshots, deep #121216 mood fields and warm neutral #EFECE7 info boards, alternating light and dark from shot to shot
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #C6A15B, one icon per callout slot, no filled or 3D icons
style.lightingSystem: high-key front-left key with soft fill on packshots, single skimming accent source on dark scenes, always one soft contact shadow, never hard cast shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium monochrome party-decor visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, deep #121216, warm neutral #EFECE7 and one champagne accent #C6A15B; neutral studio temperature with a high-key front-left key and soft fill for packshots and a single skimming accent for dark scenes, always grounded by a soft contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif only; thin single-weight line icons in the accent colour; blank label rows and empty badge outlines instead of filled data; stable rounded product geometry and consistent product scale; light neutral boards alternating with deep black fields shot to shot; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or seals.
noDrift: no invented numbers, codes or badges
style.presentationRules: stable rounded product geometry across the whole set; grouped units always graded by diameter; product never cropped by the frame edge; the same hero angle is reused for packshot and spec screens
style.surfaceSystem: pale #F4F2EE showroom floor, deep #2A2A31 plinth wall, matte #F6F4F0 console wall, all with slight real-world imperfection
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only; headline slot plus blank label rows, no serif, no handwritten or decorative lettering
